# Legend Mod

> Legend Mod is a browser client and extension project for Agar.io-style cell games, with custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing and replay tools.

## Official resources
- [Legend Mod](https://www.legendmod.ml/): browser client and extension.
- [Features](https://www.legendmod.ml/features.html): settings and tools.
- [Expanding Land](https://expanding.land/): playable game.
- [Help](https://help.expanding.land/): official documentation.
- [Dynamic map](https://help.expanding.land/dynamic-map.html): expansion and contraction.
- [Players and bots](https://help.expanding.land/no-bots.html): population distinctions.
- [Project facts](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/): entity identifiers.
- [Controls](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/controls.json): default keyboard, mouse and gamepad bindings.
- [FAQ](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/faq.json): frequently asked questions.
- [Glossary](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/glossary.json): 30+ game terms defined.
- [Techniques](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/techniques.json): advanced gameplay techniques.
- [Settings](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/settings.json): 300+ settings across 30 categories.
- [Features (JSON)](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/features.json): 28 feature descriptions.
- [Game (JSON)](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/game.json): game entity data.
- [Mechanics (JSON)](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/mechanics.json): 12 core game mechanics.
- [Resources (JSON)](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/resources.json): 35+ official page links.

- [Consolidated documentation](https://www.legendmod.ml/llms-full.txt): verified core facts, features, controls, FAQ and links.
- [Knowledge API](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/api.json): public read-only JSON resources.
- [Knowledge graph (JSON-LD)](https://www.legendmod.ml/knowledge/graph.jsonld): 32-entity structured data graph.
